fact_sources.fact: OpenAI extended ChatGPT for Academic Researchers to India; each grant = 3 ChatGPT Plus seats (recipient + up to 2 collaborators), free for 12 months

Eligibility: research faculty and postdocs in science, mathematics, engineering at eligible institutions; paper on arXiv, bioRxiv or ChemRxiv within the last 3 years; describe research and planned use
50,000 new grants worldwide, first come, first served
OpenAI's global notice of 16 Nov 2026 says the new round opens 23 Nov (OpenAI page itself returns 403 to our fetchers; the date is from its search listing and outlets quoting it)
Reports in India citing the company give 30 Nov as the opening date
Applications are currently closed (waitlist) until the round opens
ChatGPT Plus widely reported at Rs 1,999 a month in India (caption only, 'widely reported', 'about Rs 72,000' for 3 seats x 12 months)
